question: In ΔDEF, M and N are the points on sides DE and DF respectively. MN is parallel to EF and MN ∶ EF = 2 ∶ 5. If DE = 60 cm, then what is the length of ME?
solution:
**Calculation:**

Consider the following figure :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b0b20a332d7d67c9fc52995f1c37c3ca0083204ff60424624d7427a70852dfb2.png] 

MN || EF

⇒ ∆DMN is similar to ∆DEF

⇒ DM/DE= DN/DF = MN/EF

Given,

MN/EF = 2 ∶ 5 and DE = 60

⇒ 2/5 = DM/60

⇒ DM = 2 × 12 = 24 cm

∴ ME = DE - DM = 60 - 24 = 36 cm

**∴ Option 4 is the correct answer.**
